summary: An excerpt from Book 11 (part 102) of a novel, set at a school in Wareham. Rebecca Randall waits by a window as Huldah and Mr. Aladdin return from the woods, then feels an unexpected jealous pang at the thought of sharing Mr. Aladdin's friendship with Huldah. Mr. Aladdin then visits Rebecca, they reminisce, and he explains that he is a school trustee in memory of his mother, whose final happy years were spent at the school.
one_line: Rebecca Randall feels a jealous pang over Mr. Aladdin's attention when he visits her at the Wareham school.
key_facts: Rebecca Randall sees Huldah and Mr. Aladdin coming out of the woods path, with Huldah wearing a black and white veil and a coquettish hat.
Rebecca feels a sudden storm in her heart at the thought of giving up her share of Mr. Aladdin's friendship to Huldah.
Rebecca realizes Emma Jane Perkins had only ever held a secondary place in Mr. Aladdin's regard.
Mr. Aladdin enters and says that Miss Maxwell told him he would find Miss Rebecca Randall there.
Mr. Aladdin does not remember the name of Emma Jane, whom he calls the rich blacksmith's daughter.
Mr. Aladdin had not seen Rebecca for several months and had already inquired about her progress from Mr. Morrison.
Mr. Aladdin must drive to Portland for a meeting of railway directors the next day.
Mr. Aladdin says he visits the school on these trips to give advice on its educational and financial affairs.
Rebecca finds it funny that Mr. Aladdin is a school trustee.
Mr. Aladdin says he accepted the trusteeship in memory of his poor little mother, whose last happy years were spent at the school.
Mr. Aladdin states he is thirty-two years old.
